intro: Every photo below is a project our own crew designed and installed — no renderings, no catalog shots. You will see ten-foot islands with back-to-back storage, full-height backsplashes, tiled showers, mudroom benches, and beam-and-cabinetry work in older Wyoming Valley homes that had nowhere obvious to put any of it. If you see a detail you want in your own room, bring it up at your consultation; most of what is here started as a homeowner pointing at something.
